interpretationLimits: Actual online AudioWorklet PCM, not OfflineAudioContext, fabricated unit-value curves, physical speakers, or hardware loopback.
The output is muted only AFTER capture. Continuous captured PCM does not exclude downstream OS/hardware underrun or an audible real-media glitch.
Synthetic ConstantSource signals isolate gain automation; they do not establish the cause of every crackle or cover decoding, HLS, recovery, or media-source behavior.

Source helpers are extracted verbatim with individual and whole-file SHA-256 hashes. Baseline caller construction is the historical 129-point Float32 plan with 15ms lead; candidate uses its own actual plan, timing, and paired scheduler.
Every cancel/set/ramp wrapper applies its requested deterministic minimum wall overhead BEFORE calling the real native method. The control is 0ms. Native time plus imposed overhead is measured.
Clock anchors are sampled in the same task. AudioContext.currentTime can remain frozen while the wall clock advances; wall-compensated lead is only an estimate, not exact render-thread receipt time.
Captured frames and stop markers use AudioWorklet currentFrame/sampleRate. Port acknowledgement is quantum-boundary evidence, not exact AudioParam application timing.
A finite 128ms lead cannot guarantee timely delivery under arbitrary main-thread/render-queue delay. Short windows and optional blocked cases are reported without filtering or changing deadlines.
Each build is compared against its own actual piecewise-linear plan. Candidate knot approximation is not confused with an automation jump. Endpoint validation allows one 128-frame render quantum.
One run per matrix cell is a bounded reproduction, not a statistical guarantee. Firefox headless on this host is not equivalent to all user devices.

comparison.criterion: A discrete jump requires adjacent delta >= max(2e-7, 10 * this schedule ideal maximum adjacent delta), AND trajectory error > max(2e-6, 2 * ideal maximum adjacent delta). Expected trajectory is each actual plan piecewise-linear interpolation, not analytic crossfadeGains.
comparison.finiteLeadLimit: No finite submission lead guarantees continuity under unbounded task/render-queue delay. Negative wall-compensated lead and short/blocked cases remain evidence, not excluded failures.

timing.note: Wall compensation is an estimate, not a render-thread AudioParam receipt timestamp.
